english: the cause of a defeat, the reason one lost
notes: chapter title: No.054 敗因

english: motivation, the drive to do something
notes: text: ちょっとやる気? — "feeling a little motivated?"

english: to be out of one's mind, to have lost it (slang)
notes: text: 自分の腕を…いかれてやがるぜ — "his own arm... the guy's lost his mind"

english: to hide, to conceal
notes: text: ヒソカがスカーフで右腕をおおいかくしたぞ!! — "Hisoka has completely hidden his right arm with a scarf!!" (覆い隠す)

english: the power of precognition, a foreseeing ability
notes: text: ボクの予知能力をお見せしようか — "shall I show you my power of foresight?"

english: to flutter/dance up into the air
notes: text: 右腕が消えてトランプが宙に舞う?! — "his right arm vanished and cards go fluttering into the air?!"

english: to call to mind, to picture in one's head
notes: text: この中から1つ好きな数を選んで頭に思い浮かべて — "pick one number you like from among these and picture it in your head"

english: in advance, beforehand
notes: text: ボクにはその答えがあらかじめわかってた — "I already knew the answer in advance"

english: a magic trick, sleight of hand
notes: text: まさに狂気!!悪魔の手品です!! — "truly madness!! it's a demon's sleight of hand!!"

english: to secretly rig or set up (a trick) in advance
notes: text: 自分の傷口にネタを仕込んでいました — "he had rigged the trick material into his own wound"

english: a wound, a cut
notes: text: 自分の傷口にネタを仕込んでいました — "he had rigged the trick material into his own wound"

english: madness, insanity
notes: text: まさに狂気!! — "truly madness!!"

kana: いっさいかんけいない
english: to have absolutely nothing to do with (something)
notes: text: Pにも試合にも一切関係なし!! — "it has nothing at all to do with points or the match!!"

english: to reach an extreme, to be at its peak
notes: text: ヒソカの異常性ここに極まれり!! — "Hisoka's abnormality reaches its peak right here!!"

english: composure, margin, room to spare
notes: text: あいつの余裕は何なんだ!? — "what's with that guy's composure!?"

english: to slice off, to cut/shave away
notes: text: 左腕もそぎおとしてくれる!! — "I'll slice off your left arm too!!"

english: fiercely, furiously
notes: text: カストロ選手の片方が猛然と突進 — "Castro's remaining arm charges fiercely forward"

english: scum, a vile/contemptible person
notes: text: 下衆め… — "you scum..."

english: just as (one) wishes, exactly as hoped
notes: text: 望み通りにしてやる!! — "I'll give you exactly what you asked for!!"

english: to offer up, to present humbly (to a superior)
notes: text: ヒソカ選手残った左腕をも自ら献上 — "Hisoka voluntarily offers up even his remaining left arm"

english: a clone, a duplicate/split body
notes: text: 分身の方で攻撃してきたか… — "so he attacked with the clone, huh..."; the furigana here jokingly renders it "ダブル" ("double") instead of the standard ぶんしん

english: the real body, the main body (as opposed to a copy)
notes: text: もし本体で攻撃してきたらカウンターくれてやろうと思ったのに… — "if he'd attacked with his real body, I was going to give him a counter, but..."

english: a trick, a device, a mechanism
notes: text: さてどんな仕掛けでしょう? — "now, what kind of trick is this, I wonder?"

english: to return to its original state
notes: text: 切られたはずの右腕が!?元に戻ってる — "the right arm that should've been cut off...is back to normal!?"

english: a feat, a stunt (usually impressive or skillful)
notes: text: こんな芸当が可能なのは念を使っているからだ — "such a feat is only possible because he's using Nen"

english: conjuring, sleight-of-hand magic
notes: text: タネがわからないから驚く…奇術の基本だ — "you're surprised because you don't know the trick's secret... that's the basics of conjuring"

english: a pity, regrettable, unfortunate
notes: text: 非常に残念だ — "very unfortunate"

english: a skilled practitioner or user (of an ability)
notes: text: キミは才能にあふれた使い手になる… — "you would've become a user overflowing with talent..."

english: to let live, to keep alive
notes: text: そう思ったからこそ生かしておいたのに — "precisely because I thought that, I let you live, but..."

english: to deal with, to cope with, to handle
notes: text: それに対処する方法もね — "and I have a way to deal with that too"

english: to dance wildly, to dance oneself into a frenzy
notes: text: キミは踊り狂って死ぬ — "you will dance yourself into a frenzy and die"

english: the real thing, the genuine article
notes: text: な…なぜ本物を…!? — "wh-why the real one...!?"

english: to reproduce, to recreate
notes: text: 戦いの際中にできた汚れまでは再現しきれない — "he can't fully reproduce even the dirt that got on him during the fight"

english: in the midst of, during (something)
notes: text: 戦いの際中にできた汚れまでは再現しきれない — "even the dirt from during the fight, he can't fully reproduce"

english: dirt, grime, a stain
notes: text: 戦いの際中にできた汚れまでは再現しきれない — "even the dirt that got on him during the fight, he can't fully reproduce"

english: to dodge, to avoid
notes: text: だから次の攻撃をよけることもムリ — "so dodging the next attack is impossible too"

english: perfectly, flawlessly
notes: text: ムリムリ完璧に下アゴにヒットさせたから — "impossible, impossible — because I landed it perfectly on his jaw"

english: the lower jaw
notes: text: 完璧に下アゴにヒットさせたから — "because I landed it perfectly on his lower jaw"

english: will, volition, one's own intention
notes: text: しばらく自分の意志では動けない — "for a while he won't be able to move of his own will"

english: to defend against, to block, to prevent
notes: text: 分身を使ってトランプを防ぐことはムリ — "using a clone to block the cards is impossible"

english: to create, to bring into being
notes: text: 分身を作り出すには高い集中力が必要 — "creating a clone requires a high level of concentration"

english: concentration, power of focus
notes: text: 分身を作り出すには高い集中力が必要 — "creating a clone requires a high level of concentration"

english: normal, in a normal state
notes: text: それは正常な状態だからこそ — "that's precisely because it's a normal state"

english: a state, a condition
notes: text: それは正常な状態だからこそ — "that's precisely because it's a normal state"

english: complex, complicated
notes: text: 「人間」のように複雑なものを念で再現し — "reproducing something as complex as a 'human' with Nen"

english: capacity, volume (of a resource)
notes: text: ボクはそれを「容量が足りなくなる」と表現している — "I describe that as 'running out of capacity'"; the furigana here reads 容量 as "メモリ" ("memory", a computer term), a recurring gag reading for Hisoka's ability

english: to express, to describe
notes: text: ボクはそれを「容量が足りなくなる」と表現している — "I describe that as 'running out of capacity'"

english: a waste, wasteful use (of something)
notes: text: キミの敗因は容量のムダ使い — "the cause of your defeat is wasteful use of your capacity"

english: a condition, a requirement, a term
notes: from the closing caption titling this segment: 6 ヒソカの条件(完) — "Hisoka's Condition (End)"
